uberon.label: aorta
uberon.definition: The main trunk of the systemic arterial system that carries blood from the heart to all the organs and other structures of the body, bringing oxygenated blood to all parts of the body in the systemic circulation.

uberon.label: arch of aorta
uberon.definition: The convex portion of the aorta between the ascending and descending parts of the aorta; branches from it include the brachiocephalic trunk, the left common carotid artery, and the left subclavian artery; the brachiocephalic trunk further splits to form the right subclavian artery and the right common carotid artery.

uberon.label: aortic valve
uberon.definition: Cardiac valve which has as its parts the anterior, right posterior and left posterior cusps, attached to the fibrous ring of aortic valve.[FMA].

uberon.label: ascending aorta
uberon.definition: The ascending aorta is the portion of the aorta in a two-pass circulatory system that lies between the heart and the arch of aorta[GO]. A portion of the aorta commencing at the upper part of the base of the left ventricle, on a level with the lower border of the third costal cartilage behind the left half of the sternum; it passes obliquely upward, forward, and to the right, in the direction of the heart's axis, as high as the upper border of the second right costal cartilage, describing a slight curve in its course, and being situated, about 6 cm behind the posterior surface of the sternum. The total length is about 5 cm in length [Wikipedia].

uberon.label: brachiocephalic artery
uberon.definition: The short first aortic arch branch and divides into the right subclavian artery and the right common carotid artery.

uberon.label: brachiocephalic artery
uberon.definition: The short first aortic arch branch and divides into the right subclavian artery and the right common carotid artery.

uberon.label: brachiocephalic artery
uberon.definition: The short first aortic arch branch and divides into the right subclavian artery and the right common carotid artery.

uberon.label: brachiocephalic vein
uberon.definition: The left and right brachiocephalic veins in the upper chest are formed by the union of each corresponding internal jugular vein and subclavian vein. This is at the level of the sternoclavicular joint. These great vessels merge to form the superior vena cava. The brachiocephalic veins are the major veins returning blood to the superior vena cava.

uberon.label: cardiac vein
uberon.definition: Vein of heart that drains the myocardium.

uberon.label: coronary sinus
uberon.definition: The short trunk that recieves most of the cardiac veins carrying the blood from the myocardium and delivers it to the right atrium, with the sinoatrial connection occurring between the inferior vena cava and the atrioventricular orifice.

uberon.label: descending aorta
uberon.definition: The descending aorta is the portion of the aorta in a two-pass circulatory system from the arch of aorta to the point where it divides into the common iliac arteries[GO]. The descending aorta is part of the aorta, the largest artery in the body. The descending aorta is the part of the aorta beginning at the aortic arch that runs down through the chest and abdomen. The descending aorta is divided into two portions, the thoracic and abdominal, in correspondence with the two great cavities of the trunk in which it is situated. Within the abdomen, the descending aorta branches into the two common iliac arteries which serve the legs. [WP,unvetted].

uberon.label: great vein of heart
uberon.definition: The Great Cardiac Vein (left coronary vein) begins at the apex of the heart and ascends along the anterior longitudinal sulcus to the base of the ventricles. It then curves to the left in the coronary sulcus, and reaching the back of the heart, opens into the left extremity of the coronary sinus. It receives tributaries from the left atrium and from both ventricles: one, the left marginal vein, is of considerable size, and ascends along the left margin of the heart.

uberon.label: heart
uberon.definition: A myogenic muscular circulatory organ found in the vertebrate cardiovascular system composed of chambers of cardiac muscle. It is the primary circulatory organ.

uberon.label: heart left ventricle
uberon.definition: A cardiac ventricle that is in the left side of the heart.

uberon.label: heart right ventricle
uberon.definition: A cardiac ventricle that is in the right side of the heart.

uberon.label: inferior vena cava
uberon.definition: A vein that carries deoxygenated blood from the lower half of the body into the right atrium of the heart.

uberon.label: interventricular septum
uberon.definition: Cardiac septum which separates the right ventricle from the left ventricle.[FMA].

uberon.label: left anterior descending artery
uberon.definition: An artery that branches from the left coronary artery and supplies the anterior wall of the left ventricle, the interventricular septum, and the apex of the heart.

uberon.label: left cardiac atrium
uberon.definition: A cardiac atrium that is in the left side of the heart. It receives oxygenated blood from the pulmonary veins, In mammals this is pumped into the left ventricle, via the Mitral valve.

uberon.label: left common carotid artery plus branches
uberon.definition: The leftmost of the two common carotid arteries, originating from the aortic arch in the thorax.

uberon.label: left common carotid artery plus branches
uberon.definition: The leftmost of the two common carotid arteries, originating from the aortic arch in the thorax.

uberon.label: left coronary artery
uberon.definition: Coronary artery which runs along the left side of the heart and predominantly supplies the mycocardium of the left side of the heart[Wikipedia,modified].

uberon.label: left subclavian artery
uberon.definition: The subclavian artery that supplies the left pectoral appendage.

uberon.label: left subclavian artery
uberon.definition: The subclavian artery that supplies the left pectoral appendage.

uberon.label: left subclavian artery
uberon.definition: The subclavian artery that supplies the left pectoral appendage.

uberon.label: middle cardiac vein
uberon.definition: The middle cardiac vein commences at the apex of the heart, ascends in the posterior longitudinal sulcus, and ends in the coronary sinus near its right extremity.

uberon.label: mitral valve
uberon.definition: An atrioventricular valve that is part of the outflow part of the left atrium.

uberon.label: papillary muscle of heart
uberon.definition: One of the group of myocardial bundles which terminate in the chordae tendineae that attach to the cusps of the atrioventricular valves; each ventricle has an anterior and a posterior papillary muscle; the right ventricle sometimes has a septal papillary muscle.

uberon.label: pulmonary artery
uberon.definition: An artery that carries deoxygenated blood from heart to the lungs. They are the only arteries (other than umbilical arteries in the fetus) that carry deoxygenated blood..

uberon.label: left pulmonary artery
uberon.definition: The pulmonary artery that supplies the left lung.

uberon.label: right pulmonary artery
uberon.definition: The pulmonary artery that supplies the right lung.

uberon.label: pulmonary trunk
uberon.definition: An arterial trunk which is continuous with the heart and branches into the pulmonary arteries.

uberon.label: pulmonary valve
uberon.definition: The semilunar valve of the heart that lies between the right ventricle and the pulmonary artery.

uberon.label: pulmonary vein
uberon.definition: Pulmonary veins are blood vessels that transport blood from the lungs to the heart[GO].

uberon.label: left inferior pulmonary vein
uberon.definition: A pulmonary vein that drains blood from the inferior lobe of the left lung.

uberon.label: left superior pulmonary vein
uberon.definition: A pulmonary vein that drains blood from the superior lobe and lingula of the left lung.

uberon.label: right inferior pulmonary vein
uberon.definition: A pulmonary vein that drains blood from the inferior lobe of the right lung.

uberon.label: right superior pulmonary vein
uberon.definition: A pulmonary vein that drains blood from the superior and middle lobes of the right lung.

uberon.label: right cardiac atrium
uberon.definition: A cardiac atrium that is in the right side of the heart. It receives deoxygenated blood. In mammals, this comes from the superior and inferior vena cava and the coronary sinus, and pumps it into the right ventricle through the tricuspid valve.

uberon.label: right coronary artery
uberon.definition: Coronary artery which runs along the right side of the heart and predominantly supplies the mycocardium of the right side of the heart[Wikipedia,modified].

crosswalk.label: marginal branch of right coronary artery

uberon.label: right marginal artery
uberon.definition: An artery that is a branch of the right coronary artery. It follows the acute margin of the heart supplying blood to the right ventricle.

crosswalk.label: Posterior interventricular branch of right coronary artery

uberon.label: small cardiac vein
uberon.definition: A vein running parallel to the right coronary artery in the coronary sulcus that drains into the right extremity of the coronary sinus.

uberon.label: anterior vena cava
uberon.definition: A vein that carries deoxygenated blood from the upper half of the body into the right atrium of the heart.

uberon.label: tricuspid valve
uberon.definition: An atrioventricular valve that is part of the outflow part of the right atrium.

uberon.label: vena cava
uberon.definition: Any of the veins that carries deoxygenated blood from a part of the body into the right atrium of the heart.
